subject: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tracy Huang <tracy.huang@quantumhealth.com>, partners@quantumhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items

Morning Tracy —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick summary of the open items we discussed on the GCP co-sell front (pulling in our PMs for visibility):

1) Listing gating: we still need the marketplace listing contact at GCP to confirm the listing window and whether Quantum Health qualifies for co-sell credits in the first 90 days.
2) Demo environment: Quantum asked for short-lived demo instances in us-central1 that mirror their production tokens quota — need GCP partner approval on service account and egress rules.
3) SLA ask: Quantum is requesting a 99.9% inference latency SLA for the Dedicated deployment (they have federal customers). We need to understand what exceptions GCP will accept for marketplace-backed offers.

I'm attaching an updated mutual action plan with deadlines; please review columns A-C and add any dates you want us to hold to. Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm the internal owners for demo infra and the compliance checklist?

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment tomorrow 9:30am PT to assign owners and unblock the listing. Tracy — does that work?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: QH_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Tracy Huang <tracy.huang@quantumhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items

Thanks Ben — 9:30am PT tomorrow works for me. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Co-sell credits: Quantum needs written confirmation from GCP that the listing will be eligible for co-sell within 60 days of go-live, otherwise the finance team flags it. Can Ravi loop in the GCP partner rep to confirm?
- Demo env: we can provide a snapshot of production data (anonymized) but need guidance on service account scopes and network egress to a GCP test project.
- SLA: we understand an enterprise SLA can be requested through Google Sales, but given the federal footprint we'll need the exceptions documented (data residency, logging retention).

I'll bring our legal lead if we get to contract redlines. See you tomorrow.

—Tracy
Tracy Huang | Head of Partnerships, Quantum Health

Subject: Re: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items

Ben / team —

Looking into the infra items. Quick notes from infra/PM side: 

* Demo infra owner: Marissa will own standing up the short-lived demo instances in us-central1. I will follow up with our infra ops to get a pre-approved service-account template and an egress rule doc. Expect a draft by EOD Tue.
* Marketplace listing: Ravi — can you confirm whether the partner listing route for this deal requires an early co-sell opt-in form? If so, we should get that completed in parallel with the mutual action plan.
* SLA: our standard Dedicated offer supports 99.9% availability; latency SLAs for inference are negotiated case-by-case. If Quantum requires a 99.9% P99 latency SLA, we'll need an SRE verification window and an exception for warmup/cold-start periods.

I've attached a short checklist (GCP_CoSell_Checklist.pdf) with the items I'll drive. Ben — let's use tomorrow's call to sign the checklist and lock owners.

Karthik
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items

Hi all —

Ravi here from the GCP partner team. Thanks for the heads-up. Short answers: 

1) Co-sell eligibility: Quantum Health appears to meet the initial co-sell criteria, but formal eligibility requires the partner opt-in form and a listing intake review. I can fast-track the intake once we have the Mutual Action Plan and a statement of use.
2) Demo project: we can provision a partner test project and a service account with the minimal scope. Please follow these steps (summary): create a read-only dataset export, create a short-lived service account (30-day TTL), and restrict egress to the GCP test project. I'll share the RFC and a short template.
3) SLA: GCP will consider a latency SLA addendum for marketplace offers, but it requires an SRE benchmark run and a review of the traffic pattern. We can schedule a 2-hour window next week to run a P99 baseline.

I'll attach the intake link and the template. Ravi
GCP Partner PM
ravi.patel@gcp-partners.google.com

Subject: Re: GCP joint pipeline ops: deconflict, SLA asks, and listing blocker items

Thanks everyone — quick recap and owners follow-up from today's call: 

- Mutual Action Plan: Ben to update milestone dates per Tracy's finance window (60-day co-sell confirmation). DONE (see attached v3).
- Demo infra: Marissa to provision test instances and share service-account template by Tue EOD (owner: marissa_cole).
- Co-sell intake: Ravi to fast-track intake once we upload the MAP and SOW (owner: ravi.patel@gcp-partners.google.com).
- SLA benchmark: Karthik / SRE to schedule a 2-hour P99 run next week (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Legal redlines: Tracy to warn if legal needs to join; Ben to hold off on final contract language until co-sell confirmation.

Open risk: Quantum's finance team may require a written co-sell commitment before committing to a listing launch date. Vanessa — can you work with finance to scope a limited credit commitment language we can propose to GCP?

Next meeting: tentative 8/3 9:30am PT. If anyone needs to change, flag here.

Best,
Ben
